notes.title: Real Shoot April 28th Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that Real Shoot will receive a massive update on April 28th! This update brings a complete overhaul to the weapon system, character animations, and even more realistic graphics, along with significant improvements to the UI and map design. Our goal is to provide an even more immersive gaming experience. Here are the key highlights of this update:

1. Comprehensive Weapon System Overhaul
We’ve completely revamped the weapon system! Players can now enjoy a wide variety of firearms, scopes, red-dot sights, infrared sights, and more. Each weapon has its own unique feel and accuracy, making combat even more intense and realistic.

We’ve also added inspection animations, similar to those found in COD, allowing players to interact with their weapons in a more detailed and immersive way.

2. Character Animations Overhaul
Character animations have been fully reworked to ensure smoother and more natural transitions. Every movement now feels more authentic and precise, making the overall gameplay experience more immersive.

3. Enhanced Graphics
This update significantly improves the visual quality of the game. The details are more refined, the environment looks more realistic, and the overall immersion is greatly enhanced. You’ll experience higher-quality visuals, with intricate lighting and physical effects.

4. UI Improvements
We’ve optimized the UI to make the experience feel even more like a bodycam. We’ve also added a compass UI to help players navigate and orient themselves. The new UI is cleaner, more intuitive, and enhances the overall gameplay flow.

5. Map and Weather System
We’ve improved the maps with more realistic environmental details, and we’ve introduced a realistic weather system that dynamically changes throughout the game, adding new challenges and further immersing players in the experience.

6. Monthly Major Updates
We are committed to delivering a major update every month, bringing fresh content and improvements to keep the game exciting. We hope you’ll enjoy the new features, and we’re looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you for your continued support and love for Real Shoot. We’ll keep working hard to optimize the game and deliver an even more polished experience. We hope you enjoy this update and look forward to your positive reviews! 🎮

Stay tuned for more exciting content!

The Real Shoot Development Team

notes.title: 02-22 Update
notes.content:
Game Update Announcement

Dear Players,

We are excited to bring you the latest update, which includes several key improvements and fixes:

1. Bug Fixes
   - We have resolved the issue where characters would sometimes experience abnormal behavior upon resurrection.
   - Various minor bugs have been addressed to enhance overall gameplay stability.

2. Menu UI Redesign
   - The game menu has been completely redesigned to offer a more sophisticated and user-friendly interface. We hope this enhances your navigation experience and makes accessing different features more intuitive.

3. Aiming Mechanics Overhaul
   - The aiming logic has been rewritten to provide a smoother and more straightforward experience. We believe this change will make targeting more precise and enjoyable.

We are committed to continuously improving your gaming experience and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your continued support!

Best regards,
West Tech

notes.title: 2025 Game Update
notes.content:
Hello players, our game has been online for more than a month, and the development team continues to develop the game every day. 
First, we've updated the map with a new one. The Record map and the Modern Desert 2 map have been made, with realistic graphics and innovative gameplay.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732537/3280c4dc307450543f452ce9e0fa77c84dd7d166.jpg[/img]
Second, we've adjusted the strength of enemies in the story map, adjusted the pace of battles in the multiplayer map, and added new teammates skins.

Thirdly, in order to increase the gameplay, we have added sniper rifles, which can be used to complete kills in desert city 2 and forest maps, bringing a refreshing game experience. And multiple gun skins have been launched.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732537/649ba07558c941ba26e1faabd2fe365846d12f93.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732537/8f2de15fac7fcaebccbdd54e69796fa7fe9a4742.jpg[/img]

We'll be updating it continuously, and the San Francisco Battle Royale mode will be available soon.

notes.title: Real Shoot Latest Update and FAQ
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to introduce Real Shoot, an ultra-realistic single-player shooting game that delivers an unparalleled immersive experience. Real Shoot features 20 to 30 highly detailed environments, including various styles such as Chinese, American, Russian, African, and European, catering to diverse player preferences.

The game offers a wide array of cool firearms and equipment, all of which can be unlocked for free by completing in-game missions, ensuring a fair play environment for everyone.

In our latest update, we have added a mobile recording perspective UI to enhance the immersive experience, while still retaining the bodycam perspective. We have optimized the visuals to minimize screen shaking, and players can now customize the perspective mode to suit their preferences.

Furthermore, Real Shoot now supports over 30 languages, making it accessible to players worldwide.

The game is set to be released soon, and we sincerely invite you to add Real Shoot to your wishlist. Your support means the world to us. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment. We are eager to hear your feedback.

Thank you for your attention and support!
